scope: macOS filesystem event retention during checkout removal and bounded acknowledgement socket fixture

baseline.test_change: Force immediate reconciliation after deleting the worktree and surviving checkout file; report both missing conditions without extending the five-second deadline.

fixes: Independent FSEvents stream per checkout and Git metadata; other Unix hosts retain shared watcher.

limits: Source content matches the recorded commit; targeted/stress and the standard gate began before that identical content was committed.
Retains the failed baseline and CI failures; passing stress runs do not erase them.
One native FSEvents stream per checkout changes macOS resource use; this is not overnight or many-project resource acceptance.
No installed launcher, production daemon, registry or user session was replaced.
